rewrites.comment: Client-side routing: every unmatched path serves the app shell. Static files are matched before rewrites, so /assets/* is unaffected. Without this, a hard refresh on /portal/enquiries or a shared /recommendations/<id> link 404s.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a new build gets new URLs.
The shell must never be cached, or a deploy serves stale asset references.
